best_idea: A death leaves a lootable pile only with a chance that depends on depth, so starter zones never carry corpse loot and deeper zones do; one draw at death decides the pile and each item rolls separately.
decision_why: Keep the depth-gated pile chance as zone data; drop the drop-everything, the 80% curse and the monster hand-off, which conflict with take-one loot and the one ledger.
acceptance: A death in a starter zone leaves no lootable pile; in a deep zone the share of deaths leaving a pile matches the zone's chance within 3 points over 10,000 seeded deaths, and the killer can take one item from it.
